title: Stanford Computer Science Human–Agent Co-learning Program Inventory

scope.included: Substantive CS-coded courses numbered below 400 that are present in current/recent official Stanford CS department schedules, plus active catalog courses needed for prerequisite continuity. Includes undergraduate and graduate lecture/project courses and selected cross-listed CS offerings.
scope.excluded: ACE/problem-solving labs, independent study/research registration, CPT, TGR, administrative seminars/departmental lecture series, and courses numbered 400+; these can be added in a later archival/research layer.
scope.anti_hallucination_policy: Course code/title must have an official Stanford schedule/catalog/course-site evidence URL. Unknown public-video status is unverified rather than guessed.

dependency_dag.edge_semantics: from -> to is a learning/enrollment dependency. kind=prerequisite means prior completion is required/assumed; kind=corequisite means concurrent enrollment is explicitly permitted/required; kind=recommended is advisory rather than mandatory. basis=official means Stanford explicitly states the relationship; inferred is a conservative learning dependency, not an enrollment rule.

youtube_verification.policy: v0.3 recency-gated policy (reference 2026-09): a YouTube course binding qualifies as confirmed_recent only when a public Stanford/course lecture-series playlist can be bound to an offering in Autumn 2023 or later. Historical confirmed playlists older than the cutoff are retained as archived and MUST NOT enter generation_queue. none_found still means a dedicated search found no qualifying public YouTube series at the time of verification; pending_verification at the program-material layer means no accepted recent material binding is currently available.

material_policy.rule: Only public course materials bound to an offering in Autumn 2023 or later qualify as active_recent. Older confirmed material is retained as archived evidence but MUST NOT enter the generation queue. Unbound or not-yet-qualified material remains pending_verification.
material_policy.youtube_rule: A YouTube binding is accepted as current program material only when the course/lecture series is publicly accessible, attributable to Stanford/the course, and the bound offering is Autumn 2023 or later. Historical playlists remain recorded only under archived material.
material_policy.other_video_rule: SEE.stanford.edu or official Stanford course video/archive pages may be bound in public_materials.other_video only when the usable recording set is from Autumn 2023 or later. Older archives are not accepted as active program material.
material_policy.generation_rule: generation_queue contains active_recent courses only; archived nodes remain in the canonical course registry and dependency DAG for historical/provenance purposes.

v06_changes.correction: searched_not_found courses had evidence_status=SOURCE_CONFIRMED, which contradicts 'no official playlist found'. v06_changes.rationale: Owner decision 2026-09-26: evidence_status must reflect whether content was verified against an official source. searched_not_found = none_found on public playlist => cannot be SOURCE_CONFIRMED.
